name: excel-csv-import
title: Robust Excel CSV import
prompt:
`load_students(path)` in `importer.py` must handle CSV files exported from Excel:
- UTF-8 with or without a BOM
- delimiter `,` or `;` — detect it from the header line
- fields may be quoted when they contain the delimiter (e.g. `"Zitouni, Lina"`)
- grades may use a decimal comma (`12,5`) or a dot (`12.5`)
- blank lines are ignored; surrounding spaces in fields are stripped
Header is always `name<delim>group<delim>grade`. Return a list of dicts
`{"name": str, "group": str, "grade": float}` in file order.
